d: Role Description The Arabic Teacher is a full-time, on-site position based at American Academy School in Doha, Qatar. Bachelor’s degree in Arabic Language, Education, or a related field.

Working directly with the Regional Head of PR & Communications, this individual will support the coordination and execution of day-to-day communications activities, collaborate with external agencies and internal stakeholders, and help ensure the timely delivery of regional initiatives. d: We are seeking an elite, results-driven Corporate Finance Director to lead our corporate finance, capital structuring, treasury operations, and debt capital markets activities. The ideal candidate will possess an uncompromised institutional background in engineering complex syndicated loans, executing Sukuk issuances, managing large-scale corporate liquidity, ensuring IPO readiness, and maintaining robust banking and regulatory relationships (CMA / SAMA) within the Saudi market.
q: Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or related fields. (MBA, CFA, or professional certifications such as CMA/ACCA are a strong preference).
Experience: 12–15+ years of progressive experience in corporate finance, investment banking (IBD), or corporate treasury, with a proven track record within the Saudi or GCC market.
Track Record: Demonstrated hands-on leadership in closing major financing transactions (e.g., multi-billion-riyal syndicated loans, Sukuk issuances, or complex debt restructurings).
Technical Mastery: Advanced financial modeling (DCF, LBO, debt sizing, and sensitivity analysis), deep understanding of credit rating processes, and covenant management.
Regulatory Knowledge: Deep-rooted expertise in CMA regulations, Saudi Company Law, and banking documentation (LMA standards, ISDA master agreements).
Languages: Bilingual fluency in Arabic and English (Mandatory for stakeholder and regulatory negotiations in KSA).
r: Lead the end-to-end structuring, negotiation, and execution of large-scale corporate debt, syndicated bank facilities, and bilateral loans.
Oversee domestic and international Sukuk issuances, debt-to-equity conversions, and capital structure optimizations.
Manage relationships with local and international commercial banks, financial institutions, and debt advisors to secure competitive financing terms and covenants.
Direct enterprise-wide cash flow forecasting, liquidity planning, and working capital optimization.
Formulate and implement hedging strategies to mitigate interest rate, foreign exchange, and commodity price risks.
Monitor banking facilities, fee structures, and return on invested cash across multi-entity operations.
Collaborate with the M&A and Investment teams to provide financial modeling, valuation oversight, and funding strategies for acquisitions and strategic joint ventures.
Spearhead IPO readiness programs (TASI / Nomu), ensuring financial, governance, and regulatory compliance ahead of public market entry.
Coordinate financial and tax due diligence workstreams alongside external advisors and legal counsels.
Ensure full compliance with Capital Market Authority (CMA) regulations, Saudi Central Bank (SAMA) guidelines, ZATCA tax rules, and local corporate governance standards.
Prepare high-level financial reports, debt service cover ratio (DSCR) analyses, and strategic briefing packs for the Board of Directors and Investment Committee.

d: Company Description X Bankers Mortgage is a UAE-based mortgage advisory firm that supports individuals, homeowners, professionals, and property investors in navigating the mortgage and property financing process. The company provides personalized guidance across home mortgages, investment property finance, property purchase finance, and mortgage refinancing. X Bankers Mortgage focuses on tailored financial solutions that meet diverse client needs and goals. Team members work in a dynamic environment that values expert advice, client trust, and long-term relationships.

Role Description The Mortgage Consultant role is a full-time remote position responsible for advising clients on mortgage and property financing options from initial inquiry through closing. Day-to-day activities include assessing client financial profiles, explaining mortgage products, preparing and reviewing applications, and coordinating documentation with lenders and other stakeholders. The Mortgage Consultant will provide ongoing customer service, respond to inquiries, and ensure clients understand terms, conditions, and timelines. This role also involves staying current with mortgage industry trends and regulations, maintaining accurate records, and contributing to continuous improvement of advisory processes.
q: Candidates should possess strong knowledge of the Mortgage Industry and Mortgages, with experience advising on home loans and property financing solutions.
Candidates should possess solid Finance and Mortgage Lending skills, including financial analysis, affordability assessments, and understanding of lending criteria.
Candidates should possess excellent Customer Service skills, with the ability to communicate clearly, build trust, and manage client expectations throughout the process.
Proven experience in mortgage consulting, banking, or financial services is highly beneficial.
Strong analytical, organizational, and time management abilities, with attention to detail in documentation and compliance.
Comfort working remotely, using digital tools and CRM systems, and collaborating with cross-functional teams.
Relevant academic background in finance, business, economics, or a related field is preferred.
